entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to make a return? I'm not really sure how it works. It's for a helmet I bought a while ago.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's... uh... 774-B3-901. I just find all this so confusing. The website had so many options.

No problem at all, I've got the order pulled up right here. I see the Aero-Lid helmet. Before we go further, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A fault? I don't think so. I mean, the box is still unopened. I just... the color wasn't what I expected when I saw it through the little window on the packaging. I just feel so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course. It's completely understandable you'd want the right color, especially for your primary safety gear. Getting the perfect helmet is important. Let me just review the policy for your order.
Okay, one moment... Yes, it looks like your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. You're all set.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it. So I can send it back?

Absolutely. Since the box is unopened, that makes it very simple. I've just processed the return authorization and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You can just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Wow, that was so easy. Thank you so much, Diana. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
